data.exact_reserve_text: As at 31 December 2021, Syndicate 1110 is declaring a loss of GBP 46.3m (2020: profit of GBP 5.9m) of which GBP 3.4m is attributable to 2020 year of account, GBP 41.8m to 2019 and GBP 1.1m to 2017 & prior years of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Single policyholder accumulation of complex casualty claims
prior_year_events.impact_description: Large, complex claims emerging that gave rise to material uncertainty and a significant increase in reserves for the 2019 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Unconfirmed reinsurance balances with ProSight Specialty Group
prior_year_events.impact_description: Unable to obtain final confirmation of reinsurance balances which prevented closure of the 2017 year of account and maintained uncertainty in those reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 206.4m. During 2021 there was adverse prioryear development totalling GBP 46.3m (a strengthening of reserves), driven primarily by complex, accumulated casualty claims relating to a single policyholder (mainly affecting reinsurance/casualty business) and by uncertainty over reinsurance recoveries and coverage. This resulted in a reported loss attributable to prior years (notably 2019 and earlier) and prevented closure of some older years where reinsurance balances remain unresolved.
raw_causal_phrases: material uncertainty arising from a potential accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder.
The claims in question are very complex, due to uncertainty over coverage, liability and the quantum of the claims.
The 2019 YOA has not been able to close at 36 months, due to material uncertainty arising from a potential accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder.

The 2017 YOA has not been able to close at 60 months, by way of RITC, as a result of continuing to be unable to obtain final confirmation regarding reinsurance balances with ProSight Speciality Group, who are the major reinsurer of the liabilities of this Syndicate.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the year-of-account breakdown (explicitly stated loss by year). The breakdown appears to be year-of-account results (attributable losses) rather than a movement-in-provision note; accepted as primary source per instructions. There is a small discrepancy between the balance sheet comparative (206,415) and the technical reserves note (206,422) for opening gross claims; Balance Sheet figure was used. Claims development triangle present but partially difficult to transcribe; triangle data provided in 'claims triangle' section is best-effort from the printed table.
